title: Nikola Bartunkova beats Aryna Sabalenka at China Open
summary:
Nikola Bartunkova beat world number two Aryna Sabalenka at the China Open. A report published on 4 October 2026 described the win as a surprise. Bartunkova, a Czech player ranked 34th in the world, won 6-4, 6-3. She will play Austria’s Sinja Kraus next.

Bartunkova said she focused on herself and tried to stay calm. She called Sabalenka a legend and said she was very happy to win. The report described this as a season in which Bartunkova was making big progress.

A day earlier, top seed Elena Rybakina lost to Armenia’s Alina Charaeva, ranked 118th. Rybakina had beaten Sabalenka in last month’s US Open final. She then took Sabalenka’s place as world number one.

Seeds are players given leading places in a tournament’s draw because of their rankings. For the first time since 2015, both of the China Open’s top two seeds failed to reach the round of 16.

Sabalenka had five chances to win a game when Bartunkova was serving. These chances are called break points. She did not win any of them. She has now lost six matches in a row in which she lost the first set.

Sabalenka’s latest titles came in March. She won Indian Wells and then the Miami Open. Winning both events is called the “Sunshine Double”.
why_it_matters: Bartunkova beat a player ranked much higher than her. The result also meant that both of the China Open’s top two seeds missed the round of 16 for the first time since 2015.
